ledger.sentence: On 27 July 2026 the World Health Organization (WHO) published a progress assessment of its Global Health Sector Strategies on HIV, viral hepatitis and sexually transmitted infections for 2022 to 2030.
The WHO says integration is one of the biggest opportunities to speed progress, and that countries with the strongest results deliver HIV, hepatitis and STI care through primary health care.
It also points to innovation, including long-acting prevention such as twice-yearly lenacapavir, and to stronger community leadership and community-generated data.
